top.title: Anthropic gets its first court win over the Pentagon’s supply-chain risk label
top.summary: A federal judge ruled the Trump administration illegally labeled Anthropic a supply-chain risk, handing the AI company a victory as its second Pentagon lawsuit continues in Washington.

topIndia.title: Meta’s India, Southeast Asia VP Sandhya Devanathan moves to OpenAI
topIndia.summary: Devanathan will join OpenAI as Vice President for Southeast Asia and Australia in October, overseeing consumer growth, enterprise adoption, partnerships, regulatory engagement and operations.

events.summary: The ⁠MHS ⁠enables AI agents to operate lab ​and manufacturing instruments such as microscopes and robotic ​arms in tandem and perform complex tasks, ranging from routine drug ​discovery experiments to ⁠laser calibration ‌on a quantum computer, ​Anthropic ​said.

events.title: Anthropic plans to publicly unveil IPO prospectus after Labour Day
events.summary: Anthropic is planning to unveil its IPO prospectus ​after Labour Day, with ​a potential listing in late September or ​early October, The Information reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the process. The startup confidentially filed for a public listing earlier thi…

events.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT ads in India
events.summary: The ads will be for logged-in adult customers, the OpenAI announced in a statement. The company said that Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Education subscriptions will remain ad-free. WPP and Omnicom will be OpenAI’s first agency partners for ChatGPT Ads in India.
